Your goal is to help the user develop a Commodore 64 game.

Use the skill defined in `../skills/game-development/SKILL.md` as the single source of truth for execution.

This prompt only identifies the intent: write, port or extend a game. The target is modern (C64U / Ultimate 64 family, default) or authentic (stock C64). Read `c64://gamedev/index` first and follow its reading plan.
